meta.name: wasm
meta.description: WebAssembly environment rules for tinywasm MCP server, frontend Go compatibility (tinywasm/fmt, tinywasm/time, tinywasm/json), and binary optimization. Use when working on WASM frontend code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化 WebAssembly 二进制并配置运行环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Go 开发 WebAssembly 前端应用
copy.tagline_en: Optimize WebAssembly binaries and configure runtime environment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing WebAssembly frontend apps with Go

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过全局 MCP 服务器（端口 6060）管理 WebAssembly 项目，自动使用 tinywasm/fmt、tinywasm/time、tinywasm/json 等兼容库编写前端 Go 代码，并避免在 WASM 代码中使用 map 以减少二进制体积。
howto.when: 当你在开发 WebAssembly 前端项目，或需要处理 tinywasm MCP 服务器相关任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 tinywasm/fmt 替换 fmt 包写一段输出代码。
say.note: Claude 会使用 tinywasm/fmt 替代标准库。

say.text: 启动 tinywasm 开发环境并监控编译。
把这段 Go 代码中的 map 改成 struct 以优化 WASM 体积。
say.note: Claude 会移除 map 声明。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude manages WebAssembly projects via the global MCP server (port 6060), automatically uses tinywasm/fmt, tinywasm/time, tinywasm/json for frontend Go code, and avoids map declarations in WASM code to reduce binary size.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are developing WebAssembly frontend projects or need to work with the tinywasm MCP server.

say_en.text: Replace fmt with tinywasm/fmt for this output code.
say_en.note: Claude will use tinywasm/fmt instead of standard library.

say_en.text: Start tinywasm dev environment and watch for changes.
say_en.note: Claude will call the start_development tool.

say_en.text: Change this map to a struct to optimize WASM binary size.
